tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card. Near-black with a green cast.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Card surface (Card, StatTile, SourceStatus). The default ground for text.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised surface: hover rows, tooltips, the selected segment of SegmentedControl, skill-tree node body.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Tracks and wells: progress-ring track, AllocationBar gaps, chart gridline band, table header row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline card borders and table dividers. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis baseline; dividers inside dense panels.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: SegmentedControl outline, ghost Button, locked skill-node ring, unlit tree edges. 3:1 on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and hero numbers on bg-000 through bg-300 (13.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: card meta, legend labels, table secondary columns. On bg-000 through bg-300 (6.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: axis ticks, timestamps, uppercase eyebrow labels. On bg-000 through bg-300 (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Growth. Positive deltas (always with ▲), rising series, mastered skills, live sync dot, primary Button fill. Text on bg-000 through bg-300.

tokens.name: up-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind positive Delta chips and the 'up' Badge; area fill base under rising charts.

tokens.name: on-up
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `up` fill (primary Button, mastered node glyph). 10.6:1.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Loss. Negative deltas (always with ▼), falling series, sync errors. Text on bg-000 through bg-300 (5.2:1 or better). Told apart from `up` by glyph, not hue.

tokens.name: down-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind negative Delta chips and the 'down' Badge.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Attention without loss: stale sync, skills available to unlock, goals behind pace. Text on bg-000 through bg-300.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind 'warn' Badge and stale SourceStatus.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral highlight: syncing state, selected-range focus, informational Badge. Chart series 2.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind the 'info' Badge.

tokens.name: sure-received
tokens.usage: Money in the bank. Solid fill in PayoutBar, IncomeForecast and FreedomMeter.

tokens.name: sure-secured
tokens.usage: Money that is prepaid, in escrow or invoiced: very likely. Fill only (6.2:1 on bg-100); always paired with the word Secured.

tokens.name: sure-committed
tokens.usage: Money agreed but not funded, and active (non-recurring) income in FreedomMeter. Fill only (3.5:1 on bg-100); always with its word.

tokens.name: sure-pipeline
tokens.usage: Proposed money, weighted by odds. Drawn as a hatched outline, never solid, and never counted in totals.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 — the primary metric in any chart (net worth, revenue, followers).

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (e.g. IBKR in allocation, comparison period in trends).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (e.g. PayPal in allocation).

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (e.g. cash / other). 7:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 — the catch-all 'Other' slice. Never more than five series in one chart.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 11:1 or better on every surface.

styles.name: num-hero
styles.usage: The one headline figure on a screen — net worth. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: num-md
styles.usage: Table values, funnel counts, legend amounts.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row labels, skill names, emphasis inside body.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above numbers (StatTile label, section eyebrows).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-number gap in Delta; legend swatch gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, chip padding, SegmentedControl inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside a card (label → value → delta).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gutter between cards on mobile; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter between cards on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding; skill-tree row pitch unit.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, Badge, Delta, table row hover, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, SegmentedControl, skill nodes, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels — the 'slightly rounded' default.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots, AllocationBar ends, progress tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on bg-000. Top inner highlight plus a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Tooltips and popovers on bg-200.

tokens.name: glow-up
tokens.usage: Mastered skill nodes and the active tree path. Nowhere else.

duration.note: Motion timings. Wrap every animation in prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → instant.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, tab switch.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Tooltips, segment slide, row expand.

tokens.name: dur-chart
tokens.usage: Line draw, bar grow, number count-up on first render and range change.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything entering: chart draw, bar grow, count-up, tooltip in.

tokens.name: ease-inout
tokens.usage: Things moving between two positions: SegmentedControl thumb, tree camera pan.
